metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 2022 · All of Us Are Dead
metas.description: A high school becomes ground zero for a zombie virus outbreak. Trapped students must fight their way out or turn into one of the rabid infected.

metas.name: ★ 8.5 · 2016 · Guardian: The Lonely and Great God
metas.description: In his quest for a bride to break his immortal curse, Dokkaebi, a 939-year-old guardian of souls, meets a grim reaper and a sprightly student with a tragic past.

metas.name: ★ 8.7 · 2022 · Alchemy of Souls
metas.description: Set in a fictional country called Daeho, it is about the love and growth of young mages as they overcome their twisted fates due to a forbidden magic spell known as the "alchemy of souls", which allows souls to switch bodies.

metas.name: ★ 8.4 · 2023 · Death's Game
metas.description: Facing hardships and contemplating suicide after a series of setbacks, a man is confronted by Death and tasked with experiencing death over and over again through 13 other lives to earn the chance to live.

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 2023 · My Demon
metas.description: A pitiless demon becomes powerless after getting entangled with an icy heiress, who may hold the key to his lost abilities -- and his heart.

metas.name: ★ 8.1 · 2020 · The King: Eternal Monarch
metas.description: A modern-day Korean emperor passes through a mysterious portal and into a parallel world, where he encounters a feisty police detective.

metas.name: ★ 8.1 · 2013 · My Love from Another Star
metas.description: Do Min-Joon, an alien that came to our planet 400 years ago, will be able to return to his planet in 3 months, but when he meets famous actress Chun Song-Yi, all the centuries he spent distancing himself from humans come to an end.

metas.name: ★ 8.5 · 2024 · Lovely Runner
metas.description: Right after top star Ryoo Seon-jae ends his life, his top fan Im Sol somehow time-travels back to when they were in high school and tries to protect him. A fantasy romance unfolds where people who missed each other in time finally...

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 2021 · Happiness
metas.description: An apocalyptic thriller that takes place in a time in which infectious diseases have become the new normal.

metas.name: ★ 8.1 · 2016 · Legend of the Blue Sea
metas.description: A mermaid from the Joseon period ends up in present-day Seoul, where she crosses paths with a swindler who may have ties to someone from her past.

metas.name: ★ 8.8 · 2023 · Twinkling Watermelon
metas.description: "Sparkling Watermelon" will tell the story of a boy living a double life between a model student and a band member who gets to time slip and meets his 18-year-old father. The two will build friendships there.

metas.name: ★ 8.5 · 2020 · Mr. Queen
metas.description: When a modern day chef gets trapped in the body of a queen in the Joseon era, chaos ensues.

metas.name: ★ 8.0 · 2025 · Bon Appetit, Your Majesty
metas.description: French chef Yeon Ji Yeong wins a top competition but mysteriously lands in Joseon Dynasty, where she must cook fusion royal cuisine for a tyrannical king with an extremely sensitive palate.

metas.name: ★ 8.6 · 2016 · Moon Lovers: Scarlet Heart Ryeo
metas.description: Ha-jin travels 1000 years back in time and lands in the era of Goryeo Dynasty as a young girl named Hae-soo. She, now trapped in another person's body, becomes involved in a power struggle against various vicious contenders to the...

metas.name: ★ 8.0 · 2020 · The Uncanny Counter
metas.description: Noodle shop employees by day and demon hunters by night, the Counters use special abilities to chase down malevolent spirits that prey on humans.

metas.name: ★ 7.9 · 2020 · Tale of the Nine Tailed
metas.description: An urban dark fantasy drama about a gumiho who settles into the city and a producer who is after it.

metas.name: ★ 8.2 · 2017 · While You Were Sleeping
metas.description: The drama is about a woman, Nam Hong Joo, who can see accidents that take place in the future through her dreams. And a prosecutor, Jung Jae Chan, who struggles to stop the woman's dreams from coming true.

metas.name: ★ 7.8 · 2024 · Marry My Husband
metas.description: A story about Ji-won who after being killed by her husband who had an affair with her best friend, goes back 10 years in the past and has a chance to change her fate.

metas.name: ★ 8.4 · 2016 · Signal
metas.description: A cold-case profiler in 2015 and a detective in 1989 work together to solve a series of related murders spanning three decades using a special walkie-talkie to communicate with each other.

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 2023 · See You in My 19th Life
metas.description: Ban Ji-eun can remember all her past lives. When her previous life is cut short by a tragic accident, she sets out to reunite with a man named Moon Seo-ha whom she met in her 18th life.

metas.name: ★ 7.8 · 2021 · Doom at Your Service
metas.description: Tak Dong Kyung lives a fairly ordinary life until she stumbles into an unexpected fate and ends up signing a hundred-day contract with Myul Mang, risking her everything.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 2023 · Destined with You
metas.description: Follows a successful lawyer who has everything, but who is plagued by a family curse, and turns out that the one who holds the secret to breaking it is the seemingly ordinary civil servant.

metas.name: ★ 8.0 · 2010 · Secret Garden
metas.description: Gil Ra-im is a tough stuntwoman with a soft heart. Kim Joo-won is a nit-picky CEO with a long list of complexes. Love-struck, Joo-won barges into Ra-im's life in all the wrong ways, trying to make sense of his illogical feelings.

metas.name: ★ 8.0 · 2023 · A Time Called You
metas.description: A grieving woman magically travels through time to 1998, where she meets a man with an uncanny resemblance to her late love.

metas.name: ★ 7.9 · 2017 · A Korean Odyssey
metas.description: In 2017, Son Oh Gong and Ma Wang are in conflict with each other and they look for a true light in a dark world where evils exists everywhere.

metas.name: ★ 8.2 · 2019 · Arthdal Chronicles
metas.description: "Arthdal Chronicles" depicts the birth of civilization and nations in ancient times. It is a story of mythical heroes--their struggle, unity, and love of people living in a virtual land called Arth.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2022 · The Sound of Magic
metas.description: When she was little, Yun Ai dreamed of becoming a magician. But in reality, she's just a high school student who can't even afford new socks. After meeting a mysterious magician at a carnival, she decides to follow her dream.

metas.name: ★ 8.0 · 2013 · The Master's Sun
metas.description: Tae Gong Sil has the ability to see ghosts, but their constant demands for help make her life impossible until she meets Joo Jong Won, a handsome CEO who measures everything by money, since when she touches him, the ghosts disappear.

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 2021 · My Roommate Is a Gumiho
metas.description: The thrilling love story of Shin Woo Yeo, a 999-years-old gumiho who wants to become human, and Lee Dam, who accidentally swallowed his fox bead.

metas.name: ★ 7.9 · 2015 · Oh My Ghost
metas.description: Timid Na Bong Sun gets possessed by the ghost of a confident young woman who seeks to solve her one unfinished business by hooking up with Bong Sun's boss, famous chef Kang Sun Woo.

metas.name: ★ 8.1 · 2022 · Reborn Rich
metas.description: After ten years, a loyal employee is framed for embezzlement, then murdered by his employers, only to be reborn as their youngest son with a yearning for revenge guiding his hostile takeover.

metas.name: ★ 8.0 · 2013 · I Hear Your Voice
metas.description: A sharp female lawyer with no filter teams up with a public defender and a high-school student with special gifts to bring down a killer with a personal vendetta.

metas.name: ★ 7.8 · 2024 · The Judge from Hell
metas.description: Kang Bit Na, an elite judge with a beautiful appearance, is a demon whose mission is to punish those who have wronged others and send them to Hell. However, the righteous Detective Han Da On is determined to change her ways.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 2024 · The Atypical Family
metas.description: Bok Gwi Joo's family has supernatural abilities. He can revisit happy past moments. Depression causes him to lose this power. His family also loses abilities due to modern issues. Do Da He joins their household, instigating change.

metas.name: ★ 8.1 · 2020 · 18 Again
metas.description: A 37-year-old man on the verge of being divorced from his wife suddenly finds himself inside his 18-year-old body. He starts living a new life under a new name to get closer to his children and protect them.

metas.name: ★ 7.8 · 2017 · Black
metas.description: A man possessed by death. A woman who can see death. The earthly and the afterworld collide dangerously.
